options: Ordinary food supplies an amino acid he cannot clear, and withholding it prevents the toxic metabolites
A gene defect means diet cannot change what reaches the brain
Musty urine means the restricted sibling still needed an unrestricted diet
Fair hair means the injury is from pigment, not from a dietary amino acid
Well parents mean neither child can accumulate a dietary amino acid
correctAnswer: Ordinary food supplies an amino acid he cannot clear, and withholding it prevents the toxic metabolites
explanation: The sibling is protected because ordinary food supplies an amino acid the enzyme cannot clear, and his diet withholds that load. Ordinary food supplies an amino acid he cannot clear, and withholding it prevents the toxic metabolites. A gene defect means diet cannot change what reaches the brain is how the substrate was limited. Musty urine means the restricted sibling still needed an unrestricted diet is the unrestricted child. Fair hair means the injury is from pigment, not from a dietary amino acid is the missing product of the same pathway. Well parents mean neither child can accumulate a dietary amino acid are carriers.
